theme: A quiet Thursday, most of it already behind you.
greeting: Most of today is done, Dan — a domestic morning, one midday call, an open evening. What's left is the Croatia prep quietly stacking up before you sail on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on the Eurowings Discover legs; the p1 to verify the allowance on the operating carrier's site is days overdue. Two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on, and airport-counter fees run far higher than pre-purchase.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night, Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: Still open and overdue: one refundable Cavtat room plus a noon marina transfer for the last night off the charter, before the 7:30 AM Sunday flight. It has to be booked from dry land before you leave on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing-gap lodging
needsAttention.detail: Two nights, Sept 20-21, between landing at TPA and the Tuesday kid pickup, are still unbooked. Everything else across that stretch is locked.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus final sailing payment
needsAttention.detail: Amy at Nautilus and a QuickBooks reminder both flag the final course payment (invoice 2170, $6,475) as due ahead of the September charter.

needsAttention.title: Passport packet counter-ready
needsAttention.detail: The four girls' passport appointment lands tomorrow. Mike's packet still needs the DS-11s printed and a State Dept check written — one missing document sends all four applications home.

schedule.title: Nolan Haskovec's birthday
schedule.detail: A note if you have a moment

flagged.title: Liberty Mutual home renewal
flagged.detail: Your home policy renewal notice arrived Tuesday — worth a look before it auto-renews.

flagged.title: A sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Filia F. responded to the sitter job you posted.

inbox.noise: The rest is receipts, a rental agreement, and newsletters.

resolved.title: Sailing deck shoes sorted
resolved.detail: You closed the reopened p1 shoe reorder in person in St Pete, alongside the house-supplies run.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer means peak tomatoes, cucumbers, and herbs — a composed salad lets them shine without a stove.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: An early domestic start — kids fed, garden tended, the in-person St Pete errands run.
A single midday call breaks up an otherwise clear stretch.
The day winds down open, with nothing new on the calendar tonight.
